decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted must not be used other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling house at 28 Springwell Road and must not be occupied as primary living accommodation, a separate dwelling or for business purposes.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding at the rear garden of the house
